title: Navigation
description: Offline OpenStreetMap navigation for Georgia (Georgian and English) in place of the BMW map: GPU map at 60 fps, turn-by-turn guidance, speed limits, and the console's NAV button
mapsComment: The map, kept out of git (hexlay/idrive7-geo-map-data releases): kit/tools/build.py downloads it (once, into kit/tools/.osm-cache), checks its size and SHA-256 and puts it into the package unpacked. A new map: a new release there and its numbers here.

de.bmw.infotainment.KombiIF._optional: fuel level and range: range on arrival, fuel stops and the low-fuel button

settings.label: Position
options: Car (demo drive only off the car)

settings.label: Open Navigation
options: NAV button and the BMW map (side menu, tile, voice)

config.comment: positioning: the car's own GNSS / navigation position, when known for this firmware (run deploy/car/nav-recon.sh on the car to find it). Each entry: { iface, instance, field, lat, lon, heading, speed (dotted paths into the field's value), scale: { lat, lon, heading, speed } (multipliers to degrees / km/h) }. Add the interface to "signals" too, with "_optional". Empty: speed and turn rate along the roads (dead reckoning) from the last position or one set on the map.
config.navButtonComment: navButton: what the console's NAV button sends, so pressing it opens this app on top of the stock screen. The HMI always gets the button too (nothing is blocked): with this app not running, NAV works as stock. Two sources: the controller gate's read-only button feed (mgu-inputgate.so built from kit/renderd/inputgate, and /var/opt/mgu-inputgate/buttons, which the installer creates), or a SOME/IP field: iface + field from deploy/car/nav-recon.sh (add it to signals with _optional). match: byte pattern in hex, xx for a byte that changes (a counter), e.g. "xx 01 a4 xx"; the Route page can learn it (press NAV three times). Empty: learn on the car.
config.stockNavComment: stockNav: the stock BMW map, so Navigation opens in its place however it is opened (the left menu bar NAV icon, the Navigation tile, voice). Nothing is blocked or hidden: Navigation opens over it, and BACK from Navigation leaves you on the stock map without opening Navigation again. Sources: mgu-render surface lines (nav_watch = 1 in mgu-render.conf; surfaceId and / or proc of the stock map surface, at least minWidth x minHeight; the Route page learns it: tap Learn BMW map and open the BMW map from the side menu), or a SOME/IP field (iface, instance, field; match: navkey pattern of the value while the stock map is in front) found with deploy/car/nav-recon.sh (LABEL=base / LABEL=stocknav). Empty: learn on the car.
